summary: Code-quality refactor regression pass for TaxQuest. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests PASS (9.79s). Frontend: all requested flows pass — sessionStorage token switch verified end-to-end (token present in sessionStorage['taxquest_token'], absent from localStorage; reload keeps session; cookies cleared then reload — still authenticated via sessionStorage Bearer). data-testid='admin-notes' present on Admin edit textarea. Empty-catch console.warn replacement verified via api.js (no thrown errors). All console errors=0, warnings=0 during runs. Chat streaming with only Bearer token (cookies cleared) confirmed visually — Claude Sonnet 4.5 replied 'GST (Goods and Services Tax) is a consumption tax…' after page.context.clear_cookies(). ADMIN_PASSWORD loaded correctly from /app/backend/.env via load_dotenv — the module-level assert did not trip.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js response interceptor uses console.error (not console.warn) for non-401/404 statuses — the PR description says 'console.warn', functionally equivalent and still non-silent so acceptable, but wording drift worth noting.
AdminPanel edit modal: no explicit close button testid observed (only 'admin-save'); Cancel/X buttons would benefit from data-testid for teardown in future tests.

IndianQuiz and country-quiz React keys now use `${q.q}-${i}` — safe as long as no two questions share identical text; consider `q-<index>-<answerIdx>` for absolute safety if quiz seed ever gets duplicates.

sessionStorage token means a fresh tab always requires re-login even if the httpOnly cookie is still valid on the browser — /auth/me from AuthContext.refresh() will re-establish session because it also inspects document.cookie. Verified working. Just document this UX change: the previous localStorage-persistence-across-tabs is intentionally gone.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested regression flows passed (sessionStorage token verified, admin-notes testid present, admin edit persists, Indian Quiz progresses with new keys, World Explorer 48 cards + search India → 1, Save Smart India + General estimators show saved figures, Leaderboard renders with Admin, Chat streams with Bearer only after cookies cleared)

test_credentials: Admin admin@taxmaster.pro / Admin@123 (loaded from /app/backend/.env via load_dotenv — no hardcoded secrets in test file). Fresh users via /register (qa+<ts>@test.com / TestPass1).
seed_data_creation: 48 countries + admin auto-seeded on startup. Test users created dynamically per test. Admin panel edit test appended and then restored the notes on first row — no residual pollution.

The chat 'assertion' loop misfired once due to overly strict growth heuristic but the screenshot proves streaming works end-to-end with only Bearer token.
